description_en: Retrieves the metrics of the ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL AI gateway
description_zh: 获取 RDS PG AI 网关指标
name: ListLLMGatewayMetrics

parameters.help_en: The name of the Supabase instance
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en: The start time of the metric query in ISO 8601 format. The time is aligned to the minute. The maximum query time range between StartTime and EndTime is 7 days
parameters.help_zh: 指标查询的开始时间，使用 ISO 8601 格式。时间按分钟对齐，与 EndTime 组成的查询范围最大为 7 天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the metric query in ISO 8601 format. The time must be later than StartTime and is aligned to the minute. The maximum query time range is 7 days
parameters.help_zh: 指标查询的结束时间，使用 ISO 8601 格式。必须晚于 StartTime，时间按分钟对齐，查询范围最大为 7 天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The metric type. The match is case-insensitive. Valid values:
tokenPerMinute: token usage per minute.
requestPerMinute: requests per minute.
errorRequestPerMinute: error requests per minute.
timeToFirstToken: time to first token percentiles
parameters.help_zh: 指标类型，匹配时忽略大小写。取值：tokenPerMinute（每分钟 Token 用量）、requestPerMinute（每分钟请求数）、errorRequestPerMinute（每分钟错误请求数）、timeToFirstToken（首 Token 延迟百分位）
parameters.name: metric_type

parameters.help_en: The time granularity. Default value: minute
parameters.name: granularity

parameters.help_en: The model filter condition. Separate multiple model names with commas. If this parameter is not specified, data for all models is returned
parameters.help_zh: 模型过滤条件。多个模型名称使用英文逗号分隔；不传时返回所有模型的数据
parameters.name: model

Granularity.description_en: The time granularity of the returned metric data
Granularity.description_zh: 返回指标数据的时间粒度

MetricItems.description_en: The list of metric series. Each element contains the metric key, model name, unit, and list of data points
MetricItems.description_zh: 指标序列列表。每个元素包含指标键名、模型名称、单位和数据点列表

DataPoints.description_en: The list of minute-level data points for the metric series
DataPoints.description_zh: 该指标序列的分钟级数据点列表

Timestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp of the minute to which the data point belongs, in milliseconds
Timestamp.description_zh: 数据点所在分钟的 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒

Value.description_en: The metric value, returned as a string
Value.description_zh: 指标值，以字符串形式返回

Key.description_en: The metric key. For tokenPerMinute, valid values are inputTokens, outputTokens, implicitCachedTokens, explicitCachedTokens, and totalTokens. For requestPerMinute, the value is requestPerMinute. For errorRequestPerMinute, the value is the HTTP status code. For timeToFirstToken, valid values are averageTimeToFirstTokenMs, p50TimeToFirstTokenMs, p90TimeToFirstTokenMs, p95TimeToFirstTokenMs, and p99TimeToFirstTokenMs
Key.description_zh: 指标键名。tokenPerMinute 可返回 inputTokens、outputTokens、implicitCachedTokens、explicitCachedTokens、totalTokens；requestPerMinute 返回 requestPerMinute；errorRequestPerMinute 返回 HTTP 状态码；timeToFirstToken 可返回 averageTimeToFirstTokenMs、p50TimeToFirstTokenMs、p90TimeToFirstTokenMs、p95TimeToFirstTokenMs、p99TimeToFirstTokenMs

Model.description_en: The name of the model corresponding to the metric series
Model.description_zh: 该指标序列对应的模型名称

Unit.description_en: The unit of the metric value. The unit is tokens for token usage metrics, count for request and error request metrics, and ms for time to first token metrics
Unit.description_zh: 指标值的单位。Token 用量指标为 tokens，请求数和错误请求数指标为 count，首 Token 延迟指标为 ms

MetricType.description_en: The metric type of the current request. Valid values: tokenPerMinute, requestPerMinute, errorRequestPerMinute, and timeToFirstToken
